files.Title: AFPS.ADS

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_AI

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_AbilityPickup
files.Summary:
Pickup interactable that equips an ability into AFPS_AbilitySystem the same way AFPS_WeaponObject equips a weapon into AFPS_WeaponSystem.

Equip flow (mirrors AFPS_WeaponObject): Interact / collider pickup → calls inventory.FindGridForItem with requireExplicitCategory=true. If a single-slot grid matches, AddItemToGrid runs and we wire onPlacedInEquipmentSlot / onRemovedFromEquipmentSlot on the resulting AFPS_ItemObject. AddItemToGrid does not fire onPlacedInEquipmentSlot, so we explicitly call for the slot the grid maps to.

Later drags between equipment slots and the stash run through the wired listeners (drag-out → unequip; drag-in → equip). The slot index is looked up from , so any drag into a non-ability slot (e.g. the player rearranging into a generic stash grid) leaves AbilitySystem untouched.

Drop: reactivates the world GameObject, destroys the inventory ItemObject, unequips the ability instance from AbilitySystem, throws via rigidbody. Listener is unwired first so the teardown-side onRemovedFromEquipmentSlot doesn't re-enter the handler.

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_AbilitySystem
files.Summary:
Ability system. Holds up to slots (mapped to the AbilityOne/Two/Three inputs). Two equip paths coexist:

  1. Inspector loadout — designer fills with AbilityHolder entries whose ability field points at a scene-attached AbilityBase. Those abilities are equipped from the start and are not destroyed on any unequip path.
  2. Pickup — AFPS_AbilityPickup calls with a prefab. The system instantiates a copy as a child, builds a runtime holder copying trigger defaults from the prefab, and the unequip path destroys the instance. Extend by inheriting AbilityBase and overriding ActivateAbility(bool pressed = true). Examples: Scripts/Abilities/Dash.cs, GrapplingHook.cs.

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_AmmoStateToggle.CountSource

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_AmmoStateToggle.ToggleEntry

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_AmmoStateToggle
files.Summary:
Decoupled, count-driven GameObject toggler for a weapon. Conceptually the world-space sibling of 's sprite-by-count system: instead of swapping a sprite asset on an inventory icon, it enables/disables child GameObjects on the weapon model based on a live count. The count comes either from (CurrentMag / Reserve / sum) or straight from the weapon item's stored contents — summed stack sizes (StoredStackSum) or the number of distinct stored entries (StoredItemCount), mirroring .

Semantics are cumulative ranges — every entry whose [minCount, maxCount] range contains the current count is enabled simultaneously (e.g. one visible shell GameObject per loaded round, or a low-ammo warning light active only while the count is between two bounds). Pure SetActive toggling; no sprite assignment.

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_Hitbox
files.Summary: Per-collider damage relay for body-part criticals. Sits on a child collider of a character (head, torso, limb), scales incoming damage by , can optionally bypass the owner's per-type resistance and the firing weapon's range falloff, tags the hit with for crit styling, then forwards the result to the owning . Implements so weapons can apply damage to the exact collider they hit without knowing whether it is a hitbox or the body itself. Radius damage () targets directly and therefore never receives this multiplier.

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_Interactable

Useful while a dying object plays its death/explosion effect on a delay before Destroy(). Disable also stops the host MonoBehaviour's Update/FixedUpdate (relevant for subclasses like AFPS_DragableObject which run physics per-frame).

files.Summary: One recoil output channel: baseKick + jitter per-shot, plus the solver config that drives recovery for this channel.

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_RecoilController
files.Summary:
Drives camera-rotation, weapon-rotation, and weapon-position recoil for the weapon this is attached to. Writes to AFPS_WeaponObject.recoilQuaternion / .recoilPos and AFPS_Camera.recoilQuaternion — the same fields AFPS_WeaponSystem.Update() and AFPS_Camera.LateUpdate() compose into final transforms.

Maintains an independent solver triplet + pattern/momentum tracker PER profile, so a weapon with multiple fire scripts (each with its own AFPS_RecoilProfile) doesn't lose mid-decay spring state when fire modes switch. ApplyToHost sums every cached profile's current outputs each frame.

On a weapon swap, the outgoing controller keeps ticking its camera-channel springs until they decay below CamDecayEpsilonSqr — so in-flight camera recoil decays smoothly through the swap instead of snapping to zero. Weapon-mesh channels (rotation + position) reset immediately since the mesh is no longer visible. A static frame marker coordinates the shared camera field write so the decaying outgoing controller and the active incoming controller compose multiplicatively rather than race-overwriting each other.

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_RecoilPatternStep
files.Summary: One row of a Scripted pattern — explicit per-shot deltas for all three channels.

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_RecoilProfile

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_RecoilSolverConfig

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_SpreadPellet

files.Title: AFPS.AFPS_SpreadProfile

Defines a spread cone (maxSpreadAngle) plus how individual pellets are placed inside it: Random (uniform / gaussian / ring distribution) or Fixed (hand-authored deterministic pellet layout). Fire scripts call ApplySpread() per pellet; there is no runtime state — spread is computed fresh each shot.

Lifecycle: at runtime the prefab is either pre-placed on the player (legacy / inspector loadout path) or instantiated by as a child of the system when the player equips a matching pickup. Either way, Awake binds to the player references on the host GameObject — so the script MUST live on, or under, a GameObject that carries AFPS_Movement / AFPS_PlayerSoundManager.

Trigger-defaults: the fields in the "Trigger Defaults" group below are the per-prefab authored defaults that the pickup-driven equip path copies into the runtime . They have no effect for inspector-pre-equipped holders (those carry their own copy of the same fields on AbilityHolder itself).

files.Title: AFPS.GrapplingHook
files.Summary:
High-velocity, momentum-driven grapple

On press a ray sets a fixed world-space anchor. While held, the Rigidbody is reeled toward the anchor with an eased "windup" pull that ramps to full force, and is constrained to an inextensible, ratcheting rope so it swings as a pendulum; movement input adds perpendicular swing force for player-driven arcs. The rope conserves and compounds kinetic energy, so releasing slingshots the player forward with the accumulated momentum.

Auto-detaches when the player crouches, is reeled all the way to the anchor (slingshotting past it), looks too far away from the anchor, or drives face-on into a solid obstacle. The grapple is released by letting go of the button

All physics is applied through forces — the transform is never moved directly — and both Update and FixedUpdate are written to avoid managed allocations (no Debug.Log, no allocating physics queries, struct-only math).

files.Title: AFPS.HeadbobMode

files.Summary: Push-down automaton for menu navigation: Go pushes history, Back pops to prior state; Enter/Exit callbacks drive visibility transitions.

files.Title: AFPS.MainMenu.OptionsView
files.Summary: Tabbed options view (Video/Audio/Gameplay/Controls): binds UI Toolkit sliders/dropdowns to GameSettings, applies via SettingsService, and owns a ControlsTabView child.

files.Title: AFPS.MainMenu.PauseMenuController
files.Summary: In-game pause menu. UIDocument toggled via AFPS_UIManager.pauseMenu SetActive. Reuses OptionsPanel.uxml for parity with the main menu.

files.Title: AFPS.MainMenu.QualityPreset
files.Summary: Graphics quality tier mapped to QualitySettings.SetQualityLevel index.

files.Title: AFPS.MainMenu.RebindableEntry
files.Summary: Display metadata for one rebindable action: actionName (Input System key), UI label, and category group header.

files.Title: AFPS.MainMenu.SceneReference
files.Summary: Serializable scene pointer: stores SceneAsset in-editor, bakes path/name strings for runtime (build-safe, no SceneAsset dependency at runtime).

files.Title: AFPS.MainMenu.ViewState
files.Summary: IMenuState backed by a VisualElement: toggles view--hidden/view--active USS classes on Enter/Exit and defers focus to the first selectable button.

files.Title: AFPS.MotionMode
files.Summary: Selects between waypoint interpolation and constant-rotation (rotator) modes.

files.Title: AFPS.MovementState
files.Summary: Priority-ordered locomotion state exposed for animation, camera, and weapon systems to read each frame.

files.Title: AFPS.OverrideSlotBehaviour
files.Summary: What happens to the existing weapon when a new weapon targets its occupied slot.

files.Title: AFPS.PartialMagBehaviour
files.Summary: On reload-eject: destroy remaining rounds in the mag or return them to inventory with the mag.

files.Title: AFPS.PickupType
files.Summary: Determines pickup trigger mode: collider-entered auto-pickup vs explicit player interaction.

files.Title: AFPS.Projectile
files.Summary: In-flight projectile: FixedUpdate bounce-raycast + custom gravity, collision/trigger damage with friendly-fire filter, optional destroy-timer, and re-entrancy guard.

files.Title: AFPS.ProjectileFire
files.Summary: Instantiates a projectile prefab at fire position/direction, applies launch force/torque, consumes AFPS_WeaponAmmo, and routes hitmarker/VFX/SFX.

files.Title: AFPS.RandomAudioClipContainer
files.Summary: Clip array + min/max volume range for PlayOneShot; workaround for Unity's RandomAudioContainer being incompatible with PlayOneShot.

files.Title: AFPS.RaycastFire
files.Summary: Hitscan fire: per-pellet raycast with spread, optional bounce and pierce chains, damage falloff curve, friendly-fire filter, and optional fire delay via LeanTween.

files.Title: AFPS.RecoilChannelId
files.Summary: Identifies which of the three per-shot channels SampleChannel is being asked for.

files.Title: AFPS.RecoilPatternMode
files.Summary: Procedural: per-shot baseKick ± jitter. Scripted: ordered patternSteps array, wraps at end.

files.Title: AFPS.RecoilRecoveryMode
files.Summary: Target recovery behavior: AutoZero (snaps to 0 after delay), Continuous (accumulates, never auto-returns), Hold (freezes at last kick position).

files.Title: AFPS.RecoilSolverFactory
files.Summary: Instantiates the correct IRecoilSolver (Spring/Lerp/Curve) from an AFPS_RecoilSolverConfig.

files.Title: AFPS.RecoilSolverType
files.Summary: Motion solver implementation: Spring (closed-form, dt-independent), Lerp (two-phase chase), or Curve (AnimationCurve playback).

files.Title: AFPS.ReloadBlockingStates
files.Summary: Movement states during which reloading is blocked. A [Flags] field so several can be combined. Each value maps to a : while the player is in any selected state a reload can't start, a pending reload-hold is cancelled, and an in-progress reload is aborted.

files.Title: AFPS.RemoveStoredItem
files.Summary: Pops the last stored item from a container and makes it currentItem; hand must be empty.

files.Title: AFPS.RightClickNoItemBehaviour
files.Summary: Action taken when right-clicking a grid cell while no item is currently held.

files.Title: AFPS.RightClickWithItemBehaviour
files.Summary: Action taken when right-clicking while an item is currently held.

files.Title: AFPS.SpeedMode
files.Summary: Controls whether segment traversal time is derived from a constant speed or a fixed duration.

files.Title: AFPS.Split
files.Summary: Splits the item's stack in half via inventory.SplitStack.

files.Title: AFPS.SpreadDistribution
files.Summary: Shape of the random point cloud inside the spread cone.

files.Title: AFPS.SpreadMode
files.Summary: Random = each pellet sampled from a distribution within the cone; Fixed = each pellet reads an authored offset, wraps at the end.

files.Title: AFPS.SpringAuthoringMode
files.Summary: Raw: author stiffness/damping/mass directly. Tuned: author settleTime+dampingRatio; k/c/m derived via ω₀=4/settleTime formula.

files.Title: AFPS.SpringRecoilSolver
files.Summary: Three independent closed-form springs (one per axis). Allocation-free per tick and stable at any dt.

files.Title: AFPS.SpriteCountSource
files.Summary: Selects which count drives sprite/HUD icon swaps: own stack size, stored item count, or summed stored stack sizes.

files.Title: AFPS.StatusEffect
files.Summary: Runtime instance of a status effect: tracks build-up accumulation, remaining apply time, reapply timer, and HP/overheal deltas per tick. Instantiated from via .

files.Title: AFPS.StoredItemDescriptor
files.Summary: Serializable snapshot of one stored item: data reference, stack size, and recursively nested contents.

files.Title: AFPS.StoredItemLocationData
files.Summary: Return value from : the found cell position and rotation index (0=unrotated, 1=rotated).

files.Title: AFPS.Throw
files.Summary: Stub throw button: delegates entirely to base.OnPress(); extend OnPress to add throw logic.

files.Title: AFPS.TriggerType
files.Summary: Determines what event starts the platform (or rotator) moving.

files.Title: AFPS.UGUIHUDLayer
files.Summary: UGUI . Owns the legacy Canvas-based HUD widgets and renders the full surface. Mirrors 's patterns: epsilon-gated change detection, null-guards, pool reuse. TriggerImpulse is a no-op — UGUI impulse is delivered by components via BroadcastMessage.

files.Title: AFPS.UI.Inventory.AFPS_InventoryControllerNav
files.Summary: Gamepad cursor for the inventory UI: drives a synthetic mouse position via InputState.Change + static OverridePosition, supporting both Virtual Pointer and Grid Snap nav modes.

files.Title: AFPS.UIImpulseSettings
files.Summary: Serializable impulse preset: peak scale, gain/hold/decay durations, and per-phase LeanTween easing.

files.Title: AFPS.UIToolkitHUDLayer
files.Summary: UI Toolkit . Sits beside the player UIDocument (Source Asset = HUD.uxml). Element refs are queried in Awake; each call mutates VisualElements. Strategy: scalar writes go direct; lists (HP segments, compass markers) use lazy pools reused across pushes to avoid alloc + layout thrash; smooth transitions are USS-driven (transition-property on .crosshair, .bar-fill, …) — no C# tweens here.

files.Title: AFPS.Use
files.Summary: Stub use button: delegates entirely to base.OnPress(); extend OnPress to add use logic.

files.Title: AFPS.WeaponSwayMovementType
files.Summary: Interpolation method used for weapon sway position and rotation.

files.Title: AFPS.WeaponTiltStanceSetting
files.Summary: Per-stance position/rotation offset + duration and easing for weapon tilt transitions.
